verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS equity and fund-management platform, but nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. HRIS integrations (auto-terminating employees) are inbound syncs, an adjacent feature that does not count. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, so there is no API documentation either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
